frontmatter.name: architecture-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review architecture proposals for hidden coupling, unnecessary services, misplaced responsibilities and weak seams. Use after architecture docs or module boundaries change and before domain or implementation proceeds.

frontmatter.name: backend-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review backend routes, finance triggers, print handoff, error handling and idempotence for the Camoburguer API. Use after backend changes and before frontend or infra proceeds.

frontmatter.name: domain-db-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review the Camoburguer entity model, state transitions and database shape for integrity, drift and unnecessary complexity. Use after domain or schema changes and before backend implementation continues.

frontmatter.name: frontend-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review operator-facing screens for clarity, click count, state visibility, legibility and operational risk. Use after UI changes and before infra or QA continues.

frontmatter.name: infra-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review docker compose, service health, startup order, print bridge runtime and demo reliability. Use after infrastructure or runtime changes and before QA begins.

frontmatter.name: operator-ui-builder
frontmatter.description: Build the Camoburguer operator interface for orders, kitchen queue, cash shift and finance summary. Use when editing `apps/ops-web/` and any low-cognitive-load operational interaction.

frontmatter.name: order-finance-domain-modeler
frontmatter.description: Model the order, ticket, print job, cash shift and finance entry domain for Camoburguer. Use when defining entities, states, events, schemas or invariants that connect orders, kitchen flow and gerencial finance.

frontmatter.name: print-infra-specialist
frontmatter.description: Implement and maintain the Camoburguer print bridge, spool behavior, docker compose wiring and container health. Use when editing `apps/print-bridge/`, Dockerfiles, `docker-compose.yml` or demo runtime plumbing.

frontmatter.name: process-gate-review
frontmatter.description: Review process and workflow artifacts for ambiguity, unsafe manual steps, missing actors, broken handoffs and untracked exceptions. Use after process docs change and before architecture continues.

frontmatter.name: release-readiness-review
frontmatter.description: Consolidate process, architecture, implementation, infra and QA evidence into a final go/no-go assessment for the Camoburguer demo. Use after QA finishes and before closing the implementation cycle.

frontmatter.name: restaurant-architecture-designer
frontmatter.description: Design modules, boundaries, events, adapters and deployment shape for the Camoburguer platform. Use when updating `docs/arquitetura-do-sistema.md`, shaping app/package boundaries or deciding where order, finance and print responsibilities belong.

frontmatter.name: restaurant-backend-builder
frontmatter.description: Implement the Camoburguer API, SSE streams, automatic finance entries, print handoff and cash-shift endpoints. Use when editing `apps/api/`, backend contracts or app-to-package integration code.

frontmatter.name: restaurant-demo-qa
frontmatter.description: Validate the Camoburguer demo end to end: orders, kitchen queue, reprint, cancellation, cash shift and finance summary. Use after implementation or infra changes and before final review.

frontmatter.name: restaurant-process-orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Map actors, channels, order intake, kitchen handoff, cash routine and finance triggers for a small restaurant operation. Use when defining or updating `docs/contexto-operacional.md`, `docs/canais-e-captura.md`, `docs/ciclo-do-pedido.md` or any operational journey before architecture or coding.

frontmatter.name: finance-insight-curator
frontmatter.description: Turn Camoburguer finance entries into useful small-business insights such as ticket average, payment mix, peak hours, cancellations and channel concentration. Use when improving the financial tab, summaries or operator-facing manager metrics.

frontmatter.name: kitchen-ticket-ergonomics-review
frontmatter.description: Review the kitchen ticket for scan speed, line order, emphasis and prep readability. Use when changing ticket format, print content or `docs/padrao-ticket-cozinha.md`.

frontmatter.name: operator-friction-audit
frontmatter.description: Audit the Camoburguer operator flow for extra clicks, hidden states, confusing wording and preventable errors. Use after UI or workflow changes when the concern is operational friction rather than pure correctness.

frontmatter.name: scenario-automation-planner
frontmatter.description: Design scenario-based rules for channel labels, priority, ticket emphasis, printer routing and shift checklists without turning the product into per-client bespoke code. Use when editing scenario rules or `docs/automacoes-por-cenario.md`.
